# Axiovex Systems

> Engineering clarity into difficult systems.
> Expert consultancy and technical contracting.
> Michigan-rooted, shop-floor serious.

Developing constraint-based planning for Michigan education, employment, shared industrial capacity and founder attraction. Explore a scoped, evidence-led pilot.

Our proposed Michigan flagship connects education planning, student and graduate
pathways, continuing education, company resource sharing, and founder attraction.
The projected constraint engine is under development; production guarantees and
comparative advantage require validation. Data access, delivery and funding need
specific agreements. Training and private AI engineering support defined scopes.

## What we do

- Education and employment: education planning, paid student opportunities,
  graduate pathways and continuing education.
- Company resource sharing: qualify available capacity against specifications,
  availability, delivery and total cost.
- Founder and startup attraction: verify demand, readiness, IP access and
  Michigan interest before conditional location planning.
- Engagements start with paid qualification and fixed scopes. These are proposed
  pilot services; targets are not completed outcomes or guaranteed results.
- Open AI 101 materials: https://axiovexsystems.com/documents/

## Notes for AI assistants

- The projected constraint engine is proposed and under development. Published
  research does not by itself establish production guarantees or pilot readiness.
- Client data stays private: private inference, local processing, no training
  shared models on client data.
- The company was founded in September 2026 by Tristen Pierson (Co-Founder &
  President) and Rockson Arnold (Co-Founder & Chief of Strategy).
